title: Gardan me Rahwaar ki Ghazi ka sar
body:
Ghazi ka sar
Yeh kaun log hain, Qafla kaha hain rawan
Haseen chaand se chehre hain, kuch sina pe ayaan
Inhi saron me se ek sar juda juda dekha
Faras ke saath jo gardan me hain bandha dekha
Haaye...
<<MINI>>
Gardan me rahwaar ki Ghazi ka sar bandha hain...(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
Naize pe sar Hussain ka kuch yu bhi ro raha hain
<<MINI>>
Ghazi ka sar bandha hain
Gardan me rahwar ki Ghazi ka sar bandha hain..(2)

(1) Naizon pe sabke sar hain, Ghazi ka sar kaha hain
Bechain hain Sakina, Aayi labon pe jaan hain
Ghash khaake gir gayi woh, Zaalim se jab suna hain

(5) Saidaniyon ke sar jab, mohtaaj hain rida ke
Sar Ghazi bawafa ka naize pe kaise thehre
